limitations: The revised capability is a reviewed checkpoint revision of the original live-discovered action sequence, not a new model-generated artifact or paid discovery run. Original evidence is unchanged.
No new live provider run followed the provider/discovery hardening; local deterministic regressions exercise those changes.
Phase 4 handoff automation is test-driven; no new real-human demonstration was claimed. The earlier Phase 2 user-guided handoff remains the real-human evidence.
Fully opaque captures deliberately lose shell and business-screen visual information; structural evidence carries runtime state.
Exact pre-format per-CLI-run source diffs were not captured; the final verification source/test diff is recorded here. Fresh-checkout verification remains Phase 5.
Discovery-time human resume and durable process-crash recovery remain unsupported.
Trusted caller/profile/schema text is public configuration; arbitrary secret-bearing configuration is outside the tested minimization contract.
DOM revalidation is not an atomic transaction against hostile page mutation; this cooperative local browser/proxy boundary is not OS egress or multi-user isolation.
